_README: CMMC Level 3 (NIST SP 800-171 R2 + 800-172) reference configuration for SecRouter handling CUI. Copy, then replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. Validated at startup — the server refuses to boot (fail-closed) if this block is invalid. See docs/compliance/.

bedrock._comment: Frontier OpenAI models on Amazon Bedrock (GovCloud) via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Auth with a Bedrock API key (bearer) in AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK.

azure._comment: Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI). baseUrl = your resource endpoint (…openai.azure.us for Azure Government). Model id = your deployment name. Auth: api-key (AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY) or set azureAuth:"entra" with an entra block { tenantId, clientId, clientSecretEnv, authority:"https://login.microsoftonline.us", scope:"https://cognitiveservices.azure.us/.default" }.

_switching_note: Bedrock and Azure both speak the OpenAI chat format, so switching a tier between clouds is a one-line change: flip the primary/fallback between bedrock/openai.* and azure/<deployment> (and keep both egress rules below).

oidc._trackJti_note: Leave OFF for standard OIDC access tokens (they are multi-use bearer tokens). Setting trackJti:true enforces SINGLE-USE per jti and will reject the 2nd request that reuses a token — only enable if your IdP issues one-time tokens.

allowlist.authorization: Frontier OpenAI models via Amazon Bedrock, AWS GovCloud (US) — FedRAMP High / DoD IL4-5
Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry in Azure Government — FedRAMP High / DoD IL4-5
Self-hosted model inside the accreditation boundary

metrics._comment: Prometheus /metrics (bounded labels — no principal ids). Off unless enabled; protect with a static bearer resolved from bearerEnvKey and/or network placement, since scrapers can't do OIDC.

resilience._comment: Per-provider circuit breaker (SC availability). Opens after circuitThreshold consecutive upstream health failures so a dead provider fails fast to the next authorized model; a half-open probe is admitted after cooldownSec. healthIntervalSec>0 enables active model-list health checks (adds background egress; leave 0 for air-gapped enclaves).

mcp._comment: Governed MCP / tool-calling gateway (AC 3.1.3/3.1.5). Off unless enabled. Servers are in-boundary upstreams SecRouter brokers; tools are deny-by-default per principal via policy.allowedTools (server/tool, server/* wildcard). Every tools/call is classification-gated + audited (tool.call/tool.deny, args hashed not stored).

tls._comment: Recommended: terminate TLS + mTLS/CAC at a FIPS-validated front end and set mode=frontend (this app binds localhost). Use mode=native only on a Node build linked against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL FIPS provider.
